assessment.engineering_explanation: For this single-cup brewer scope, all required heat-up, energy-balance, and numerical-stability inputs are supplied. The 350 W case did not reach 90°C within the 300 s study duration, and the 500 W case reached it in 247.8201508770297 s, exceeding the 180 s limit. The 700 W case reached 90°C in 174.56056246993037 s and is therefore the lowest supplied candidate meeting the limit. Its refined-run crossing-time difference was 2.417310440705478e-7 s and relative energy difference was 8.878792781746648e-10, supporting numerical stability. Its reported thermal balance residual was approximately 0.0011 J against 117401.85 J modeled thermal input, supporting energy consistency. This read-only assessment does not change the retained source run's failed status, award campaign credit, or assert completion of CAD packaging, thermal screening, review, or product-safety work.
